title: mason-audit output is a CI contract – extend additively only
body: External CI pipelines and the mason-audit.yml workflow consume the 0/1/2 exit codes and the --json AuditReport shape (version: 1). Issues drive exit 1; advisories NEVER affect the exit code – an advisory that gated exit codes would deadlock the workflow's verify step, because advisories can't be closed by editing the doc. Any new check must declare itself issue-class or advisory-class up front; new report fields must be optional keys; exit-code semantics never change. Same pattern as mason-drift.
